name: tr_graves
caption:
IF ALLEN GRAVES HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🪨 Larvitar: eats a whole mountain, then sleeps to grow. From 6-1 to 6-7 in one summer
🐻 Ursaring: sniffs out all food, even buried underground. 2 straight state titles, 19 points and 20 rebounds in the second final
👑 Nidoking: a horn that can pierce a diamond. Louisiana Mr. Basketball 2024
🐈 Purrloin: its cute act is a ruse to steal your stuff. 67 steals, the most by a freshman in Santa Clara history
⚡ Luxray: rests for long stretches to store up electricity. WCC Sixth Man and Freshman of the Year
🦖 Tyranitar: Larvitar's final form, strong enough to change the landscape. Our pick 19, just 20, and 10 games into his career

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Allen Graves had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF GRAVES HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Larvitar. It eats a whole mountain, then sleeps so it can grow. Allen grew up playing football, then went from six-one to six-seven in one summer.
beats.dlg: EATS A MOUNTAIN TO GROW.|6-1 TO 6-7 IN ONE SUMMER

beats.vo: Ursaring. Its nose finds every bit of food, even buried underground. Two straight state titles, with nineteen points and twenty rebounds in the second final.
beats.dlg: FINDS ALL BURIED FOOD.|FINAL: 19 PTS, 20 REB!

beats.vo: Nidoking. Its horn is hard enough to pierce a diamond. He was Louisiana's Mister Basketball.
Purrloin. Its cute act is a trick: let your guard down, and your stuff is gone. Sixty-seven steals as a freshman, the most by a freshman in Santa Clara history.
beats.dlg: ITS CUTE ACT IS A RUSE.|67 STEALS: FROSH RECORD!

beats.vo: Luxray. It rests for long stretches to store up its electricity. Allen was his conference's Sixth Man of the Year, and Freshman of the Year.
beats.dlg: RESTS TO STORE UP ENERGY.|6TH MAN + FRESHMAN OF YEAR

beats.vo: And the ace. Tyranitar. It's what Larvitar grows into, strong enough to change the landscape. We took him nineteenth, he's just twenty, and he's ten games in.
beats.dlg: CAN RESHAPE THE LANDSCAPE.|PICK 19, JUST 20 YEARS OLD

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Grew up playing football; a growth spurt over one summer took him from 6 ft 1 in (6-1) to 6 ft 7 in (6-7); two consecutive state championships, 19 points and 20 rebounds in the senior-year state final, his second (2nd) consecutive title; Louisiana Mr. Basketball (2024); freshman at Santa Clara: 67 steals, the most by a freshman in program history; WCC Freshman of the Year and Sixth Man (6th Man) of the Year (2026); selected 19th overall by Toronto in the 2026 NBA draft; born July 28, 2006 (age 20)
